evidence.actualGap: Public original QA T4XZmMPQ9Kw decoded1744frames while captureReady=false/codec_unsupported. The later isolated selected-source shape report below establishes one observed container/clock subset, but not compressed packet equivalence, raw capture or production admission.
evidence.syntheticContainer: Root's10second synthetic VP9/AAC Matroska-to-MP4 streamcopy preserved ordered compressed payloads:300video/470audio packets. Both full decodes passed. Installed WebView2 showed VP9 video time/frame progression on the synthetic MP4; this muted test does not directly prove native AAC decoding or real-source capture.
evidence.failedClockTrial: WebM output_ts_offset1000 was present but empty_moov AAC output_ts_offset997 became tfdt0. Applying the intended rather than observed audio origin yielded300video but1of470audio packets; ffmpeg -xerror full decode still exited0. That output is failed evidence, preserved as a synthetic counterexample. A successful process, video duration or full decode alone is insufficient.
evidence.correctedClockTrial: With observed synthetic video firstPTS1000, audio firstPTS0, explicitly declared audio display offset999.979 and shared origin1000, local streamcopy preserved300/300video and470/470audio payloads/order. All video PTS matched; AAC firstPTS-0.021 remained and maximum absolute quantization difference was0.000500seconds; full decode passed. These values demonstrate a known fixture, not production clock offsets or permissible drift.
evidence.existingLimits: encoded.rs commits independently validated AVC/AAC e########.mp4 pieces capped at32MiB and120seconds. The shared downstream verifier requires video and full decode but permits optional audio. A long raw epoch must not impersonate one encoded piece or rely on that verifier to detect dropped audio.

actualShapeReport.scope: Read sanitized report directly. New public T4XZmMPQ9Kw default-UA profile, same selected source1, segments/default append window, both timestampOffset0, ad/protected/sourceObject false, playback and decoded-frame progression. No media payload, account or chat was stored. Later explicit budget limits are not parser failures or production readiness.
actualShapeReport.video: Complete observations gen4/gen5 each have150 unlaced blocks:149 SimpleBlock plus1 BlockGroup,1 BlockDuration/ReferenceBlock,1 key and149 inter first-frame headers,30 superframes with60 index-declared subframes and30 invisible first frames. VP9 profile0/8bit, TimestampScale1000000, DefaultDuration33333333ns, unknown-size Segment/Cluster. Gen4 is854x480 over46805.001..46810.001; gen5 is1280x720 over46810.001..46815.001. Last block starts46809.967/46814.967 respectively. The diagnostic inspected only bounded first-frame prefixes and superframe indexes, not all subframe payloads/dependencies.
actualShapeReport.audio: AAC44100Hz gen4 has215 samples over46804.99376417234..46809.986054421766; gen5 has216 over46809.986054421766..46815.00156462585. Equal generation numbers are not equal media endpoints: gen4 AAC ends about14.946ms before its video interval, whereas gen5 AAC alone covers the full gen5 video interval with packet-boundary excess.
actualShapeReport.repeatedInitialization: The observed source repeats EBML/MP4 initialization approximately every5seconds. A diagnostic generation counts an init boundary, not necessarily a codec change. Gen4-to-gen5 has a real dimension change; later repeated headers still require full configuration comparison before calling them equivalent. Do not create a user recording/job on every init or assume FFmpeg honors a byte-concatenation of repeated headers.

decisionAndConflicts.preferredProposal: Preserve original container bytes in a YouTube-only durable two-track spool, then use the pinned local FFmpeg demuxer/muxer in streamcopy mode after sealing. Let mature tooling handle VP9 DTS/superframe/MP4 packaging, while Atsumi independently verifies ownership, exact retained payload coverage, clocks and lifecycle. This is a proposal, not implementation approval.
decisionAndConflicts.supersededRecommendation: The shape-probe contract's preliminary preference for a handwritten VP9 sample mux is retained as an alternative, not a selected requirement. This draft proposes the raw-spool alternative because synthetic native compatibility and the audio-loss counterexample favor a smaller auditable local-remux path. Root chooses after actual shape evidence.
decisionAndConflicts.durabilityWording: The required order is durable bytes and durable journal BEFORE ACK. Any shorthand 'ACK-before-durability rule' in feasibility discussion must not be interpreted as permission to acknowledge volatile bytes.
invariants: One original video ingress; no extractor, media URL, second downloader, independent playback receiver, MediaRecorder, captureStream, codec/quality/UA coercion or production re-encoding.
No protected-media/decryption support. Unsupported or unprovable layout remains explicit and preserves accepted originals; MIME recognition alone never means recording-ready.
Keep the original player/chat UI, tab/background/minimize/tray behavior, opt-in state and hidden-keyboard rules unchanged.
Do not physically edit streaming/browser_fmp4.rs or change its AVC/AAC admission, mux, clocks, recovery or CHZZK behavior. Do not rewrite the existing AVC branch to fit WebM.
No shared SOOP/account/discovery state and no new provider-generic framework. Only a narrow closed writer dispatch and a YouTube-local implementation may be proposed.
A final video can be verified while chat is unavailable/partial; never relabel that chat complete or erase stronger retained-original requirements.

minimalTypedStages.name: ApprovedSpoolSession
minimalTypedStages.construction: Native constructor only after the existing exact document/epoch/nonce/label, request/source IDs, receiver, canonical video/channel, full RecordingOwner and current recording approval gates. A closed format tag selects YoutubeVp9AacRawV1; browser input cannot choose arbitrary demuxers, extensions, tool arguments or paths.
minimalTypedStages.owns: Job UUID, receiver/source/document generation, full manual or scheduled owner including run/generation/channel/video, cancellation guard and RAII active-job ownership. Exactly one VP9 WebM video track and one clear AAC-LC fragmented MP4 audio track, from the same selected MediaSource, are the proposed first subset. Actual observation and tests must establish the supported subset before enabling it.

minimalTypedStages.name: DurableSpoolWriter
minimalTypedStages.construction: Create_new fixed owned per-track raw storage, versioned proof and ordered journal in the new job directory. Journal exact initialization-unit extents separately from codec epochs; repeated headers must not be treated as one demuxable input by byte concatenation. The physical indexed append-file versus individually owned unit-file representation remains gated on raw-pair QA. Persist validated initialization and exact immutable clock/configuration descriptors before accepting media. Public methods accept typed track ordinal and the existing bounded chunk/index envelope, never filesystem names.
minimalTypedStages.owns: Per-track next append/chunk counters, committed offsets/hash state and a bounded last accepted receipt; streaming container framing/checkpoint state. Storage durability and container/playable-interval validity are separate facts. ACK means committed bytes, not complete or playable video.

minimalTypedStages.name: SealedSpool
minimalTypedStages.construction: Only writer stop, approved format boundary or explicitly classified interrupted recovery can seal. Complete durable bytes are immutable; journal seal records the cause, exact committed lengths, full stream hashes, final complete-container boundaries and retained partial-tail metadata.
minimalTypedStages.owns: Read-only exact inputs and an exact-owner finalization lease. No late append, cancelled arm or old epoch can reopen this writer. Raw evidence is preserved while verification is pending.

minimalTypedStages.name: RetainedPacketPlan
minimalTypedStages.construction: Bounded streaming native validation and pinned local packet projection establish input clocks/configuration, a real independently decodable video start, a complete end and corresponding AAC packet coverage. Store explicit retained/excluded counts, ordered payload folds and interval evidence, not browser-supplied claims.
minimalTypedStages.owns: One common timeline origin, exact retained packet identities/order, proven prefix/tail exclusions, expected track configuration and a deterministic tool invocation. Unknown durations, lost interior bytes or ambiguous mapping cannot produce this type.

minimalTypedStages.name: VerifiedRemuxCandidate
minimalTypedStages.construction: The local-only streamcopy attempt matches the RetainedPacketPlan for both tracks, clocks and payloads, and passes full decoding. Candidate is an owned create_new merge-UUID.mp4, not an existing user's file or e########.mp4.
minimalTypedStages.owns: A narrow call into existing verify_publish_from for final hash/publication/library proof, followed by separately authorized exact-owned cleanup only after final and chat-retention proofs are durable. Failure at any stage retains the source.

proposedSourceBoundaries.new: Prefer src-tauri/src/platform_media/youtube_spool.rs with at most small private journal/container-boundary/local-remux modules if needed. Do not create an application-wide codec abstraction.
proposedSourceBoundaries.adapter: A separately testable YouTube raw-container observer may be added beside original_capture.js, attached through its existing single hook and exact selected source. Preserve existing AVC function behavior. It calls the original append with identical this/arguments/result/exception first; observer failure cannot affect official playback. Own copied accepted bytes, never retain caller views or SharedArrayBuffer.
proposedSourceBoundaries.nativeDispatch: A narrow closed Archive backend variant or YouTube-specific begin/append/finish methods may join original.rs and encoded.rs lease/ownership plumbing after explicit assignment. Existing begin_encoded stays strict AVC/AAC. Do not pass fake AVC metadata, relax its muxer, or parse AAC by pretending it is a valid two-track AVC stream.
proposedSourceBoundaries.finalizer: The new spool finalizer joins verify_publish_from only after its stronger two-track packet/clock check. live.rs recovery needs one explicit new-proof dispatch before legacy fallback. Invalid or unsupported spool proof must not fall through as TS or encoded MP4. No ordinary download/library model migration is proposed.
proposedSourceBoundaries.sharedHelperLimit: Reuse storage validation and contained process ownership. If packet folding needs streamed stdout, add only an internal bounded fixed-schema consumer for this path; do not generalize every process call or change existing outputs. Root assigns any shared file before edits.

admissionAndContainerScope.start: The observer must know complete initialization and structural boundaries from the same selected source. Starting mid-block/mid-cluster does not authorize searching payload for magic bytes. Retain only bounded framing state or a bounded approved pre-roll; otherwise wait for the next demonstrably complete boundary/RAP within a specified startup deadline, leaving preparation explicit. No implicit second fetch fills an unavailable prefix.
admissionAndContainerScope.webm: Validate EBML/Segment/Info/Tracks, checked lengths/depth/timebase, exactly the admitted VP9 video track and complete block/container boundaries. Reject encryption, compression, unsupported lacing/configuration, external linkage and ambiguous reference/decode-start structures. A legal unknown-size Segment/Cluster is not automatically malformed, but its final retained block boundary must be proved. Actual supported lacing, DefaultDuration/BlockDuration and superframe cases await the shape report.
admissionAndContainerScope.aac: Validate a self-contained clear AAC-LC MP4 init plus coherent tfdt/tfhd/trun/mdat extents using a YouTube-local bounded reader. Preserve the currently justified AAC config normalization only where independently applicable and tested; do not broaden shared validation. Data-reference and edit-list effects must be either explicitly handled and proved or rejected, not ignored.
admissionAndContainerScope.configuration: A new init closes an input container unit and requires full revalidation, not automatically a new codec epoch/job. Preserve byte identity and compare a native validated decoder/timebase fingerprint: codec configuration, dimensions/profile/color, track identity/layout, audio config, timebase and offsets. Byte-identical valid init is an equivalent case; nonidentical metadata-only changes need an explicitly justified field policy, not guessed equivalence. Changed required fields, unknown relevant differences, source/track replacement, nondefault appendWindow, sequence mode, ad/protected interval or hook-integrity failure cannot silently join bytes. Real configuration changes may use only the existing approved continuation owner gates; repeated equivalent init must not explode into5second user files.
admissionAndContainerScope.repeatedUnitGate: Before a production writer is admitted, separate identical/equivalent repeated init, genuinely changed config and parser-incomplete init in tests and actual raw evidence. Independently demux complete original units with their clocks first. Any later reconstruction of one init plus compatible media fragments, or a verified per-unit remux/join, needs an exact retained-packet/timebase proof. Raw byte-concat, generic concat-demux normalization and per-unit timestamp zeroing are not accepted shortcuts.
admissionAndContainerScope.nativeMinimum: The native reader validates enough structure to bound and identify the supplied containers, reject external/protected data, prove committed complete extents and check timestamps. FFmpeg handles codec-specific DTS/packing. Avoid implementing a second complete VP9 decoder/muxer solely to reuse the old MP4 segment finalizer.

clockContract.snapshot: Add a closed YouTube-only begin descriptor for segments mode and finite immutable per-track timestampOffset, init timebase and same-source track ordinals. Capture it from the exact original SourceBuffer objects. Native owner/source/epoch gates and parsed container clocks must agree; arbitrary browser wall-clock timestamps or an inferred offset from arrival order are not accepted as proof.
clockContract.relation: For admitted input packets, displayTime=parsedContainerPTS/timebase+thatTrackTimestampOffset. Use one common selected-source origin for both tracks; never independently zero audio and video. Arrival order, first append time and independently normalized demuxer timestamps do not establish this relation.
clockContract.toolMapping: The RetainedPacketPlan records any difference between original container clocks and demuxer's reported clocks, including documented priming/edit offsets. Exact FFmpeg adjustments are derived from those proven facts and tested against the pinned binaries. Do not assume output_ts_offset, copyts, start_at_zero, genpts, avoid_negative_ts or a demuxer default preserves the desired relationship.
clockContract.arithmetic: Prefer checked integer ticks/rationals for native intervals and explicit finite conversion for MSE offsets. Reject overflow, reset, impossible timebase and unexplained interior discontinuity. Quantization acceptance must be derived from the relevant input/output timebase and demonstrated fixture, not the synthetic0.5ms observation or a new blanket tolerance.
clockContract.formatBoundary: A new decoder configuration gets a separate raw epoch/file. Cross-codec AVC-to-VP9 or reverse continuity is unimplemented until the existing AVC source clock and raw display clock are explicitly reconciled under the same receiver/owner. Clock reset cannot be hidden by a fresh zero origin.

selectedIntervalAndCoverage.videoStart: Select the first proved independent video random-access point within the captured complete input. Before it, partial structure or dependent frames may be retained as originals but are not claimed as saved decodable video. Record the precise excluded prefix and its cause. A container key flag alone must be reconciled with the admitted codec/dependency evidence; unknown VP9 superframe/altref dependency remains unsupported.
selectedIntervalAndCoverage.videoEnd: Select the last complete, duration/dependency-proven video interval available at the stop or format boundary. Do not invent constant frame cadence from a missing final duration. An incomplete trailing unit remains preserved and explicitly excluded. A missing interior unit is failure, not a tail exclusion.
selectedIntervalAndCoverage.audioCoverage: Video and audio SourceBuffers may arrive with different lead/lag at start and stop. Require AAC coverage across the retained video interval, allowing only independently proved packet-boundary/priming extent. Preserve an AAC packet intersecting the start/end as the plan requires; an excess audio-only prefix/tail wholly outside the selected interval may be excluded and counted. Do not require every raw packet to appear in output when these deliberate exclusions are proved, and do not conceal an in-range missing audio interval as rounding.
selectedIntervalAndCoverage.endPolicy: On a user stop, seal only already received/approved bytes plus the existing bounded in-flight drain; do not fetch or keep recording indefinitely to catch up a lagging track. If required audio cannot cover the intended complete video end, either explicitly plan a shorter fully covered tail with the excluded complete-video range and interrupted/partial outcome preserved, or fail finalization. This choice needs a separately reviewed acceptance before implementation; no successful-full-recording claim for silent truncation.
selectedIntervalAndCoverage.expectedFold: Produce per-track expected retained count, sum of payload sizes and SHA256 fold over ordered packet identity/size/payload-hash records, plus first/last PTS/DTS/duration and source-interval checks. Separately fold excluded prefix/tail with fixed reasons. The output is compared to this retained plan, not blindly to all raw packets and not merely to container duration.
selectedIntervalAndCoverage.packing: The actual source already contains30 two-frame superframe indexes per150-block unit and invisible first frames, so synthetic simple-frame success is insufficient. First test direct demuxed compressed packet grouping/size/hash preservation on one complete actual raw pair. If MP4 packaging changes grouping, record grouping_changed and preserve inputs; a later equivalence proof must validate ordered coded-frame bytes and display/decode timing/dependencies, not just frame counts. No handwritten VP9 mux or relaxed packet comparison is authorized by this observation.
selectedIntervalAndCoverage.noConcealment: Do not use -shortest, guessed -ss/-t, discardcorrupt, genpts or silent timestamp clamping to make invalid or missing coverage appear complete. A precisely selected boundary may eventually be expressed with a tested local tool option, but its actual emitted retained packet set must still equal the independently constructed plan.

durabilityAndJournal.commitOrder: For each ordered bounded IPC chunk: validate full owner/source/epoch/track/index and bounds; append owned bytes; flush/sync raw file; append a fixed-schema offset/length/hash receipt plus complete-logical-append marker as appropriate; flush/sync journal; only then ACK. Native init/proof creation and directory/publication durability must use the existing safe Windows persistence conventions. A write/flush/journal error poisons the writer and never returns a successful ACK.
durabilityAndJournal.retry: An exact repeated last committed receipt may return the same ACK without a second write. Same index with different payload/hash, missing chunk, reordering, changed owner or interleaved incomplete logical append fails closed. Do not retain an unbounded in-memory receipt map. Process crashes may leave more durable bytes than ACKed; that is handled by the journal, not by inventing a new network request.
durabilityAndJournal.records: A versioned header binds provider, codec branch, UUID job/receiver/source, document generation, exact RecordingOwner, fixed filenames, init hashes and immutable clock descriptors. Ordered append records contain typed ordinal/index/chunk, contiguous offset/length, payload hash, completion flag and bounded native receipt timing. A seal records exact lengths, stream hashes, complete extents, reason and known coverage. No URL, credentials, arbitrary path, page text or unbounded string fields.
durabilityAndJournal.streaming: Read and verify journal records incrementally with a strict maximum record size and count. Never read an hours-long journal or ffprobe packet JSON into one string/vector. Packet projection is incrementally parsed from fixed fields into bounded per-track folds and boundary summaries; never request/log raw packet bytes or arbitrary tags.
durabilityAndJournal.boundsToRatify: Keep current128KiB IPC chunk and existing64MiB sender/32MiB continuation pocket caps; no limit increase is implied. Proposed journal lines are at most1KiB with at most1,000,000 commits per epoch; proposed packet projection line cap4KiB and packet count cap100,000,000. Before phase1, root must ratify these resource ceilings and a total per-epoch raw-byte/duration/disk ceiling against multi-hour recording, plus bounded finalizer concurrency/backlog. Reaching a cap is an explicit protected stop with originals retained, not an allocation increase, silent loss or automatic new-file retry loop.
durabilityAndJournal.uiProgress: Persisted raw bytes can update real downloaded/recorded-byte progress, but a recording remains recording/finalizing/verifying as appropriate. A durable chunk, first RAP or successful FFmpeg exit is not a completed library item. Avoid fake percentages or indefinite checking status.

localToolBoundary.paths: Only fixed regular non-reparse, single-link inputs beneath the exact owned job directory, checked with storage::safe_path/regular and proof hashes. No caller path, symlink/junction, hardlink, device, UNC path, alternate-data stream, arbitrary glob, network address, playlist or concat demuxer input. Keep sealed inputs immutable through inspection/remux, using appropriate owned handles/Windows sharing restrictions and post-operation identity/hash verification rather than a check-then-close assumption.
localToolBoundary.demux: Explicit admitted demuxer per input, no autodetected manifest. Apply a minimal local protocol whitelist on every input and verification pass. file/pipe whitelisting alone does not stop local data references: reject external MP4 dref/url/urn structure, explicitly keep enable_drefs=0 and use_absolute_path=0, and reject unsupported WebM linkage/encryption. Never derive tool options from page metadata.
localToolBoundary.mapping: Use only the two admitted track ordinals, -c copy, fixed output format and a unique create_new/no-overwrite merge-UUID.mp4. Drop unneeded metadata/chapters/attachments/subtitles; do not introduce a filter, encoder, side output or automatic network lookup. Exact timestamp and packet-selection arguments remain gated on synthetic and actual proof.
localToolBoundary.process: Reuse the pinned bundled tools, hidden contained process/JobObject, isolated working directory, stripped injection/proxy environment, cancellation and bounded stderr. Add bounded streaming stdout only for the fixed packet fields/folds. Invalid schema, overlong line, timeout, process failure or cancellation fails the attempt without publishing or cleaning sources. Every ffprobe/ffmpeg pass remains inside the same cancellation/ownership scope.
localToolBoundary.verification: Before existing generic publication, require exactly the expected VP9 video and AAC audio configurations, retained payload folds/counts, source-to-output PTS/DTS interval relation and audio coverage. Then require complete decode and existing final file hashing/publication. The synthetic470to1audio counterexample must fail even though decode succeeds.

lifecycleContinuationAndChat.stop: Stop freezes writer admission, drains only already approved bounded chunks, seals both spools and detaches/persists this job's chat before a successor can attach. Finalization runs asynchronously while the original view can keep watching. RAII job ownership stays active through tool completion and durable terminal state; quit/update/reset drains still wait for real work, not a UI category.
lifecycleContinuationAndChat.rollover: Reuse the existing YouTube-local continuation controller and full scheduled-owner compare-and-swap, currentCapture lookup and off invalidation. A decoder/init change seals old raw bytes and starts an approved successor from the same live receiver; no second ingress or mixed-config concatenation. Preserve the bounded15second/32MiB pocket semantics only after a WebM-specific structural handoff is tested. Blind reuse of the MP4 moof/mdat pocket is forbidden.
lifecycleContinuationAndChat.progress: Define continuation progress as at least one durable, complete and locally validated two-track source interval, not nonzero raw bytes and not final verified media. Retain the existing no-progress and repeated-change retry ceilings; cancelled/off/new manual/account refresh/source/epoch changes invalidate pending successor authority. Delayed old finalizers may update only their own job, never replace scheduler currentCapture or restart recording.
lifecycleContinuationAndChat.continuity: At a format boundary, compare old retained source end to new retained source start under the proved common clock, including duplicate/overlap policy and bounded pocket loss. Keep the existing actual250ms continuity gate as a test ceiling, not a license to discard packets or alter clocks. If WebM boundary transfer or cross-codec mapping is not proved, this path remains incomplete and explicit rather than advertising automatic continuation as finished.
lifecycleContinuationAndChat.chatOrigin: Long raw epochs cannot use the end-of-remux wall time as replay origin. Establish a truthful YouTube-local provisional origin from the first durable, complete, selected media interval while recording, using its native receive/commit timestamp and parsed duration/source relation. Preserve that actual timestamp and receive-time-approximate quality. If startup prefix selection later advances the first retained source time, adjust only this new job's explicit mapping using the proved difference; never falsify a commit timestamp.
lifecycleContinuationAndChat.chatDeferredBoundary: The existing general affine/version2 replay redesign remains deferred. If the raw branch cannot express its truthful provisional/final mapping with the existing timeline contract, root must approve a narrow YouTube-spool-specific reader/writer version before codec admission. No shared CHZZK/SOOP timeline change, historical-file rewrite or exact-synchronization claim is authorized here.
lifecycleContinuationAndChat.chatCoverage: Keep current verified readiness/explicit unavailable/unknown distinctions and bounded recent-buffer loss accounting. Resolve pre-attachment loss with the exact job marker and actual chosen replay origin; uncertain overlap stays partial, earlier proven unrelated loss does not poison later jobs, and active-sink-written rows are not marked lost. Sticky stronger failures and source-retention policy survive finalization. Save final video and chat records independently; a missing/partial chat result is reported honestly.

recoveryDiskAndCleanup.recoveryDispatch: Recognize only the new exact versioned spool proof under an owned interrupted job. Revalidate source ownership, fixed names, regular-file identity, init/configuration, ordered journal and committed-prefix hashes before starting local-only recovery. Never resume the website/network or silently turn a manual recording into an automatic reservation.
recoveryDiskAndCleanup.crashWindows: Test crashes before raw write, after raw sync but before journal, after journal sync but before ACK, after ACK before append completion, during seal, during remux and after verified rename before terminal persistence. Uncommitted raw tails or one torn final journal record are preserved and classified interrupted. Invalid earlier records, hash mismatch, missing range or unknown ownership are not silently skipped.
recoveryDiskAndCleanup.prefixRecovery: When a committed prefix is recoverable but original files contain an uncommitted or incomplete tail, preserve the original bytes. Create a separately owned recovery input limited to the validated complete prefix if the tool cannot safely read a bounded extent. No original truncation, overwrite, guessed repair or unbounded repeat retry. Excluded tail and shorter recovered interval remain explicit.
recoveryDiskAndCleanup.disk: Normally store two append-only inputs plus final MP4, so peak storage is approximately raw total plus output and bounded proof/index overhead, not an assumed fixed2x guarantee. Faststart/tool temporary use, recovery prefix copies and concurrently finalizing epochs require additional measured reserve. Check space at admission, periodically during append and before tool/output stages; reuse existing protected reserve where applicable. Do not delete unrelated files/caches or block the original player's network to recover space.
recoveryDiskAndCleanup.cancel: User stop requests finalization of received data; user cancellation, shutdown cancellation, low space, tool failure and unsupported source are separately classified. Any unverified/cancelled output leaves raw and chat evidence. Cancellation cannot publish a partial attempt as complete or erase the last good media file.
recoveryDiskAndCleanup.cleanup: After durable verified media publication and chat-retention permission, delete only exact registered spool/journal/attempt files whose identity and hashes still match this job. Retain media.mp4, chat and necessary compact verification/ownership proof. Unknown files, different jobs, reparse targets and failed attempts are not sweep targets. Cleanup failure is a non-destructive visible follow-up state; it does not invalidate an already verified file or authorize broader deletion.

implementationPhasesPendingApproval.gate: docs/requirements/youtube-webm-raw-pair-qa-20261015.json must be fully read and approved before QA code or media collection. This gate now precedes production phase1; shape scalars alone do not authorize it.

implementationPhasesPendingApproval.gate: Root full contract review plus actual selected-source shape; no existing AVC/CHZZK behavior change.

implementationPhasesPendingApproval.scope: Local-only retained-packet planning, streamcopy, strict packet/clock verifier and recovery fixtures. Test synthetic valid and known failed clock cases, malicious references and crash windows before a live codec is admitted.
implementationPhasesPendingApproval.gate: Both complete-track verification and intentional prefix/tail selection demonstrated; tool invocation and packet streaming limits reviewed.

implementationPhasesPendingApproval.scope: Narrow exact-source YouTube adapter/bridge dispatch, provisional chat origin and manual record/stop integration, with original append semantics unchanged.
implementationPhasesPendingApproval.gate: Root assigns integration files; current AVC regressions and actual default-UA VP9 watch-to-record-to-library acceptance pass.

implementationPhasesPendingApproval.scope: WebM-aware same-receiver pocket/format continuation, exact scheduler current owner/off, crash resume and verified cleanup.
implementationPhasesPendingApproval.gate: Actual adjacent source intervals, both-track retained packets, chat boundary, off stability, reopen and lifecycle checks pass. No blanket all-codecs completion claim.

deterministic: Byte-split container headers/blocks and AAC metadata; source/init/offset change; unselected/ad/protected source; original append return/throw and caller-buffer ownership unchanged.

Native exact provider/video/channel/source/epoch/run/generation/request/job checks, malformed MIME/init, wrong track ordinal, index replay/change, duplicate ACK, reordered/chunk-missing and journal poison.
